answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers one falcon. The falcon carries a lantern-sealed parcel across the tundra, filing receipts at both ends. Auditors match both receipts on parcel hash, falcon key, and lantern seal against the tundra route log; a reused receipt burns the bond. The k-th courier costs 35+6(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked against 40,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays 35 once, bond back.
